mission_02: Excellent! You have mastered ColumnTransformer, the essential tool for handling heterogeneous tabular data. By defining separate preprocessing pipelines for numeric and categorical columns, you ensure that each data type receives the appropriate treatment while maintaining a single, unified workflow. The ColumnTransformer applies all transformations in parallel and concatenates the results, which are then fed to the final estimator. This pattern handles missing values, scaling, and encoding in one clean pipeline that prevents data leakage and ensures reproducibility. The output feature count shows how one-hot encoding expands categorical columns into multiple binary features. This architecture is the industry standard for tabular ML and forms the foundation of all production-grade data pipelines.
